units: performance.now wall milliseconds; CPU process usage and sampled CPU profiles reported separately
nestedDefinition: inclusive includes children; exclusive subtracts direct measured children only; nested inclusive values must never be added
gpuDefinition: WebGL API and Three render timings measure CPU-visible scheduling/driver calls; no GPU execution-time claim
hudStatsDefinition: world.stats runs through the established roughly 0.25-second HUD gate, not unconditionally every frame
rafDefinition: Adjacent rAF timestamps include refresh quantization and waiting; they are not JS function execution time
